instructions_to_main_agent: Phase 1: Create 'css/tokens.css' storing all exact values in vanilla CSS variables (:root). Override Bootstrap 5's native variables (--bs-primary, --bs-body-font-family, etc.) where appropriate to leverage native utility classes like 'text-primary' and 'bg-primary' automatically.

Phase 1.1: Map the gold accent (#FFD15D) to Bootstrap's --bs-warning or create a specific --bs-accent class if required, but the prompt asks for gold text to be an accent and text-primary for headings. Configure --bs-primary to the deep navy (#0A2540).
Phase 1.2: Create 'css/theme.css' to define component-specific classes (e.g., .btn-gold, .hero-section, .mega-menu) using the tokens.
Phase 2: Extract reusable HTML pieces into 'partials/header.html', 'partials/footer.html', and 'partials/product-modal.html'.

Phase 2.1: Implement 'js/include.js' using vanilla JS fetch() to dynamically inject the partials into elements like
. Handle the active state of navigation links dynamically.
Phase 3: Recreate the core pages (index.html, products.html, pricing.html, blog.html, etc.) referencing 'tokens.css', 'theme.css', and 'include.js'.
Ensure the hero section on index.html is dark with the gold accent prominently featured, as specified.
Ensure the B2B SaaS eSignature feel: high trust, clean spacing, clear typography.
Do NOT use any build tools (Webpack, Vite, npm scripts). Pure static HTML, CSS, JS.
Ensure every interactive element (buttons, form inputs, nav links) has a descriptive 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid="nav-pricing-link").
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' outputs. Provide clean, professional code.
DO NOT use a completely transparent background for headers; use solid or high-opacity backdrop-blur to ensure readability.
Do NOT center align paragraphs universally. Keep left-alignment for body text.
Emphasize accessibility and proper contrast, especially with the gold accent on dark backgrounds.
Maintain strict spacing consistency. Follow the 5rem vertical rhythm defined in spacing layout.
